title: Before it arrives
logline: The last page of the sequence: the trees, the glow between the trunks close enough to warm the page, and the page's right edge — the sequence stops here. The next page in the book is the garage.

panels.composition: Deep in the trees on the ridge, the trunks close, the ground moss and needle. Between the trunks ahead, the glow fills the gaps — ochre, warm, the wash bleeding out toward the page's right edge, which is bare. A man's back and a dog, at the left, stopped. The page ends before they move.
props: the glow, bleeding to the edge

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, deep inside a mossy conifer forest on a ridge where a warm ochre glow fills the gaps between the trunks ahead and bleeds toward the bare right edge of the page, a man seen from behind and a small three-legged dog standing stopped at the left, no words
image.notes: Bare right edge. The sequence stops before it arrives. Do not draw what's there.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Stops here. The glow at the page's edge.
